## Summary

What does this change, and why is it needed? Link the issue where it was agreed.

## Test plan

How did you check it? For example, the output of `go test ./...`, and for a change of
behavior the test that fails without it.

## Checklist

- [ ] I opened an issue first and it was agreed (not needed for a typo or a dead link).
- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by:` line (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] If I used an AI tool, I say so here and for which part, and I can explain every
      change myself.
